nodes.description: Address of the contract creator who receives the 20% commission each ride
Public counter of passengers on the train, used for jackpot modulo checks
Index of the pseudo-randomly selected winning seat
Pseudo-random value derived from blockhash and passenger count
Jackpot 1 accumulator, paid out every 5 passengers
Jackpot 2 accumulator, paid out every 50 passengers
Jackpot 3 accumulator, paid out every 500 passengers
Reused remainder value used to detect jackpot payout triggers
Fixed seat cost of 0.1 ether required from every passenger
20% share of the seat price distributed on each ride
Array of Passenger records storing passenger addresses and gains
Constructor that assigns the train driver role to the deployer
Payable fallback that handles seat purchase, commission distribution and jackpot payouts
Caller address used as passenger identity and as constructor deployer
External transfer of the 20% commission to the train driver address
External transfer of the 20% share to the pseudo-randomly selected passenger
External transfer of jackpot1 to a selected passenger every 5 rides
External transfer of jackpot2 to a selected passenger every 50 rides
External transfer of jackpot3 to a selected passenger every 500 rides
Randomness derived from blockhash and block number, predictable and miner-influenceable

edges.reason: Constructor executes with msg.sender as the deployer
Constructor stores msg.sender into traindriver, establishing the driver role
Fallback reads msg.sender to identify the buying passenger
msg.sender is pushed as the passengeraddress of a new Passenger record into passengers
percent is computed from seatprice as seatprice/10*2
Fallback increments numbofpassengers on every ride
Fallback executes the commission transfer to the train driver
traindriver is the recipient of the commission transfer
percent is the amount sent to the train driver
External transfer to traindriver can re-enter the payable fallback
numbofpassengers is added into the randomhash seed
randomhash modulo numbofpassengers determines winseat
numbofpassengers is the modulo divisor used to compute winseat
Fallback executes the payout to the winning passenger
percent is the amount sent to the winning passenger
winseat selects which passenger receives the payout
passengers array is indexed by winseat to obtain the payout address
External transfer to a passenger-controlled address can re-enter the fallback
percent is added to jackpot1 on every ride, an unchecked accumulation
percent is added to jackpot2 on every ride, an unchecked accumulation
percent is added to jackpot3 on every ride, an unchecked accumulation
numbofpassengers modulo 5, 50 and 500 is stored into modulo
modulo == 0 triggers the jackpot1 payout branch
modulo == 0 triggers the jackpot2 payout branch
modulo == 0 triggers the jackpot3 payout branch
Current jackpot1 balance is transferred out to the selected passenger
Current jackpot2 balance is transferred out to the selected passenger
Current jackpot3 balance is transferred out to the selected passenger
External jackpot1 transfer can re-enter the fallback
External jackpot2 transfer can re-enter the fallback
External jackpot3 transfer can re-enter the fallback
Fallback derives randomness from blockhash(block.number - n) and block.number
Blockhash-based value is stored into randomhash
Weak randomness is used to derive the winning seat winseat
jackpot1 is reset to zero after payout
jackpot2 is reset to zero after payout
jackpot3 is reset to zero after payout
